steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cf_dir_admin (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,repo_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,path TEXT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,path_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(4) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,subject_type VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,provider VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,namespace VARCHAR(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,external_id VARCHAR(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,subject_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,permission VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,inherit TINYINT NOT NULL,revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY acl_target_subject(repo_id,path_hash,kind,subject_hash),KEY acl_ancestors(repo_id,path_hash,id)) ENGINE=InnoDB
